Colorbar title objects

Source: R/zz-gen-shared.R
go_colorbar_title.Rd

Used for title in 37 places in the schema. go_colorbar_title() creates one; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_colorbar_title(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  font = NULL,
  side = NULL,
  text = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from. Named arguments take precedence.

...

Not used: properties must be named in full.

font

Sets this color bar's title font. A go_font() object or named list, with properties color, family, lineposition, shadow, size, style, textcase, variant and weight (see go_font()).

side

Determines the location of color bar's title with respect to the color bar. Defaults to "top" when `orientation` is "v" and defaults to "right" when `orientation` is "h". One of "right", "top", "bottom".

text

Sets the title of the color bar. String.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_colorbar_title object (a named list).

Details

These objects appear in 37 places in the plotly.js schema (properties named title), all with the same properties and rules.

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_bar(
    x = ~factor(cyl),
    y = ~mpg,
    marker = go_bar_marker(
      colorbar = go_colorbar(title = go_colorbar_title(text = "title"))
    )
  )
